edits.why: maude-v2 has no danger button; components.json falls back danger → ghost. Needs a decision (see notes).

notes: Sign out: with the documented fallback, 'Stay signed in' and 'Sign out' become two identical ghost buttons, which leaves the dialog with no clear primary. Options: make 'Sign out' btn--primary (CONTRACT §4: the primary repeats the title's verb), or keep ghost and add a local error-text tone. Proposal uses the fallback as written; pick one before applying.

Edge-state callouts (callout--warn / --error / --success / --info, artboard 'states') keep their classes. maude-v2's .callout has no tone variants, so the four render alike except for their inline status-colour icons. That's most of the point of this artboard, so a decision is needed: accept, or add local tones in GitHubIdentity.css.
Theme: kept data-theme="dark". maude-v2 is light-first; switching is one word in the wrapper.
Token-level look shifts: accent indigo → azure, larger radii, system UI / SF Mono fonts instead of Inter / JetBrains Mono.
The inline Maude mark is the v1 spark-on-bubble; maude-v2's mark lives in system/maude-v2/preview/logo. Not redrawn here.
Copy already uses plain 'Sign in / Connected / Sign out' — no conflict with the maude-v2 CONTRACT words.
